hatLines: A product marketer who owns the whole funnel, first click to paid plan.
Product-led growth, launches, campaigns that make tech feel fun.
Born left-handed, taught to write right. Both sides of the brain, wide awake.

Plenty of nerve, I see. Better be…
intro: I'm Garima, a product marketer who specialises in product-led growth campaigns and go-to-market. I own the full funnel, from the first click to the paid plan, and I make marketing fun in tech. I was born left-handed and made to switch to my right, and I like to think that's why both sides of my brain show up to work with equal energy.

heading: A Little About the Wizard Behind the Work

story.title: Where I come from
story.text: I was born left-handed and made to switch to my right. I like to think that's why both sides of my brain show up to work with equal energy: one half notices the small human things, the other half wants the numbers.

photo.alt: Garima at her laptop, chin on hand, thinking

story.title: What I studied
story.text: A B.Sc. in Economics at SVKM's NMIMS, then a Master of Global Business in Marketing at SP Jain School of Global Management across Singapore, Sydney and Dubai, where I made the Dean's List.

photo.alt: Garima at SP Jain's Singapore campus

story.title: Where I've worked
story.text: Market research at Nestlé, growth and community at Apli.ai, strategic marketing at Deloitte, GTM as a freelancer, a family hotel built in 90 days, growth and product marketing at PICE, and now India GTM and product-led growth at Coohom.

photo.alt: Garima smiling with an event lanyard

story.title: How I work
story.text: I own the full funnel, from the first click to the paid plan, and I make marketing fun in tech. I use AI for speed and keep the curiosity and taste for myself. When a brand hasn't asked for an idea, I sometimes make it anyway.
